summary: The code is syntactically valid and reasonably structured, but it fails at runtime due to a missing Person field (compliance_propensity). It also diverges significantly from the specified simulation design: mask types, per-location policies/contacts, enforcement actions, and several required metrics (e.g., costs_total, enforcement_actions_count, adoption_disparity_index) are not implemented. Main function is correctly called at global scope.

issues.description: Person dataclass lacks the compliance_propensity field, yet the constructor sets it and downstream modules use it. This causes a TypeError during Simulation.reset.
issues.location: Person dataclass definition and Simulation.reset() where Person(...) is instantiated
issues.solution: Add compliance_propensity: float = 0.5 to the Person dataclass fields so that object creation and usage in AdoptionDecisionModule work.

issues.description: Mask types and corresponding inward/outward efficacy, prices, and per-type inventories are not implemented. The RetailMarket uses a single undifferentiated inventory and price.
issues.solution: Implement mask types (none/cloth/surgical/N95), store per-type inventory and price in Retailer (e.g., Dict[str, int] inventory_masks, Dict[str, float] price_per_mask), allow agents to choose/purchase types, and apply inward/outward efficacies in transmission.

issues.description: Per-location mask policies and contact rates are not integrated into interactions. Contacts are generated globally and ignore location types and enforcement/mandate coverage.
issues.solution: Generate contacts per-location based on baseline_contact_rate and contact_rate_multiplier_by_location; apply mask_policy and enforcement_strength by location; ensure mandate coverage is location-specific.

issues.description: Several required metrics are missing or incomplete: adoption_disparity_index, enforcement_actions_count, costs_total. Compliance rate under mandate is an approximation without tracking actual mandate periods.
issues.solution: Compute adoption_disparity_index (e.g., difference/ratio between demographic groups), track enforcement actions when mandates are active (warnings/penalties), accumulate economic costs (mask purchases, penalties, enforcement/campaign costs), and compute compliance_rate_under_mandate based on days when mandates are active.

issues.description: Disease transmission ignores locations and mask types, applies a uniform mask effectiveness exponentiated by the number of mask wearers. This is a coarse approximation and deviates from specified inward/outward efficacy.
issues.solution: Use mask_type-specific inward/outward efficacies per interacting pair; incorporate location risk multipliers (ventilation/risk level) into per-contact transmission probability.

issues.description: Mandate parameters such as mandate_start_day and mandate_coverage are not used; policy uses prevalence thresholds only.
issues.solution: Incorporate mandate_start_day to trigger mandates and mandate_coverage to enable requirements by specified location types/groups; allow both threshold-based and fixed start-day triggering.

issues.description: Counterfactual incidence is sampled independently of masked transmission trials, which can bias the infection rate reduction estimation.
issues.solution: Compute counterfactual deterministically for the same contact pairs without additional Bernoulli draws (e.g., compare probabilities or reuse the same uniform variates).

issues.description: Rt is derived from a simple incidence ratio over a serial interval and not aligned to spec's effective_reproduction_number_Rt beyond name.
issues.solution: Optionally refine Rt estimation using a renewal equation with a serial interval distribution; at minimum, document approximation or provide both raw and smoothed estimates.

issues.description: get_calibrator passes JSON-loaded kwargs directly to calibrator constructors, which may raise errors if the config contains unexpected keys.
issues.solution: Filter kwargs to match the selected calibrator's __init__ signature or accept **kwargs in calibrator __init__ methods.

issues.description: A prevalence_series variable is computed but unused in evaluate(), and several observables/IO recording structures are inconsistently saved.
issues.solution: Remove unused variables; ensure IO records are collected per-module or adjust save_module_io to reflect recorded content.
